end.summary:
Named earthworm and ant; naming the full soil-animal list was practised and is not steady yet.
Practised how earthworm tunnels let in air and water and how soil animals help make rich soil; this needs another independent check.
Pihu twice said that crawling animals are insects; they later corrected this by noting that earthworms have no legs and insects have six legs.
Pihu asked to stop after the short lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised soil-animal names with Pihu and used the six-legs comparison to sort insects from earthworms. Pihu first called earthworms insects because they crawl, then corrected the mix-up later by noting that earthworms have no legs; the explanation of how soil animals help should be checked again next time. At home, ask Pihu to sort picture cards into “insect” and “not insect,” then name one way earthworms help soil.
